parse_embedding_file: parse an embedding text file into a dictionary of word and embedding tensors
load_embedding_into_module: load parsed embedding weights into a PyTorch embedding module for a given vocabulary
make_positions_tensor: replace non-padding symbols in a tensor with their position numbers starting at padding_idx+1
get_activation_function: get a callable activation function by name such as relu, gelu, tanh, or linear
clip_grad_norm: clip a gradient tensor by norm and return the original gradient norm value
